entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 192 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 21.62 kDa and pI 5.08.
Contains a Ham1p_like Pfam domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 4–187.
Has 53.2–59.7% identity and 96.4–97.4% query coverage to reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Sequence-based assignment is supported by strong homology but exact substrate preference remains inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated for this query.

entities.name: A6LGA4 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Parabacteroides distasonis; annotated as EC 3.6.1.66 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase.
Hydrolyzes XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate; binds one Mg2+ per subunit; annotated as a homodimer.
Active-site proton-acceptor feature is annotated at residue 68.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.
Reaction is reported for multiple reviewed homologs of the query sequence.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342.
Reaction is reported for multiple reviewed homologs of the query sequence.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399.
Reaction is reported for multiple reviewed homologs of the query sequence.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit for nucleotide-triphosphate pyrophosphatase activity.
